name: Word rotates
look: A word changes in a fixed-width grid cell inside an h1 or h2. The pause button sits below the heading. Refuse it if the widest alternative changes the line count at 390px.
phone: It runs on a phone as on a desktop: the word changes every two seconds, the pause button under the headline.

needs.words: An h1 or h2 with two to four alternatives in the brief. Refuse it if the widest word changes the line count at 390px.
